About Lanterns for the Long Night

lines: Good. Some work only looks lighter after you pick it back up.
Are you sure you want me to put this quest aside?

abandoned: Then I will set this aside. Come back if the work still matters.
abandoned_cooldown: Then I will set this aside for a while. Let the trail cool before asking again.
abandoned_forever: Then this matter is closed. I will not reopen it.
unavailable: There is no active trail here for me to fold away.

lines: Then keep the work close until you are ready.
Lanterns for the Long Night is still open. I can repeat the details, or close my notes if you are done.

completed: That will hold the corners of the village a little brighter. Good work.
inactive: The conditions for this quest are not right at the moment.
missing_objectives: I need 6 lanterns, not promises shaped like lanterns.
missing_proof: Bring the lanterns before we close this.
missing_target: We still need all 6 lanterns for the watch.
unavailable: This quest is not ready to close yet.

lines: Then we keep the old ones burning and hope they do not blink first.
The watch posts need light, not speeches. Six lanterns would do more than ten warnings.
Night has been leaning too close to the doors. We need more lanterns before habit becomes fear.

inactive: The conditions for this quest are not right at the moment.
reminder: Six lanterns, and sooner is better. Darkness will not wait.
unavailable: That quest is not in your hands right now.

already_completed: Lanterns for the Long Night is already settled.
locate_failed: I cannot post that request right now.
started: Bring 6 lanterns soon; this request matters less after a couple of days.
unavailable: The watch is not ready to post that request right now.

lines: Tell me those are lanterns and not another clever excuse.
Then hold onto it until you are ready to settle the matter.
